# Flow Clash service namespace

Vendored from clash-verge-service-ipc v2.7.6, commit b2a7427, under GPL-3.0.
The application and service tools build from this same source.

Flow Clash uses dev.flowclash.rev, its own service IDs, sockets, installation
roots and execution locks. Legacy Clash Verge helper removal is disabled.
The binaries retain the upstream protocol and core ownership validation.
